svg.title: The Help control opens an English-only instruction telling users to select Help.
svg.desc: Deterministic overlays will label the control HELP and the English-only panel TO FIND HELP, SELECT HELP. The working Bengali string remains undeployed pending review. Ila asks whether another button explains the explanation while the real human-help queue grows behind them.
svg.text: Page 24, panel 3 · Straight-on medium shot of the help control and its recursive instruction

text.tspan: The help control opens an English instruction
explaining how to locate the help control.
